outline:
探討有關無機物質的化學性質、原子結構及化學反應。討論在材料及礦物上之應用。
Chemical properties, atomic structure and chemical reactions of inorganic chemicals will be discussed. Their applications to material science and minerals will be discussed too.
schedule:
WEEK	CONTENT
1 ~ 5	Chapter 1. Atomic structure
Chapter 2. Molecular structures and bonding
5              midterm 1
6 ~ 10  	Chapter 3. The structures of simple solids
Chapter 4. Acids and bases
10        	midterm 2
11 ~ 15	Chapter 5. Oxidation and reduction
Chapter 6. Molecular symmetry
Chapter 7. An introduction to coordination compounds
16            Final

flexible_learning.content:
閱讀與課程內容相關之研究論文，並繳交心得報告，內容應包括論文主要研究內容、數據分析、研究成果，以及其對科學研究之主要貢獻等。

Students are required to read research papers related to the course and submit a report summarizing the main research content, data analysis, key findings, and major scientific contributions of the selected papers.
flexible_learning.outcome:
學生須繳交報告並依報告內容進行評分，占學期總成績之 10%。

Students are required to submit the report for evaluation, which accounts for 10% of the final course grade.
